## 2. Core Service Offerings & Deliverables

### A. Artificial Intelligence (AI) & RAG Systems
- **URL**: https://whizzlylab.com/services/ai
- **Overview**: Custom multi-stage RAG agents, context-aware embeddings, semantic search, and autonomous agents designed for production reliability.
- **Key Deliverables**: Multi-stage RAG architectures, LLM evaluation pipelines, vector database setup (Pinecone, Qdrant, Chroma), Hugging Face model deployment, guardrails against hallucination.
- **Technology Stack**: Python, LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI, Hugging Face, Qdrant, FastAPI, PyTorch.

### B. Real-Time Data Pipelines
- **URL**: https://whizzlylab.com/services/data-pipelines
- **Overview**: High-velocity distributed event streaming architectures that process massive event streams with sub-second latency.
- **Key Deliverables**: Apache Kafka cluster & broker configuration, Spark / PySpark streaming processors, anomaly detection engines, schema registries, automated monitoring.
- **Technology Stack**: Apache Kafka, Apache Spark, PySpark, Python, Scala, Docker, AWS Kinesis.

### C. Full-Stack Web Platforms & Systems
- **URL**: https://whizzlylab.com/services/web-development
- **Overview**: Product-grade modern web platforms, authenticated dashboards, and API microservices that load instantaneously and scale cleanly.
- **Key Deliverables**: Next.js (App Router) & React user interfaces, Python FastAPI / Flask / Node.js backend services, database schema design, containerized Docker delivery, cloud CI/CD.
- **Technology Stack**: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Python, Docker, PostgreSQL, AWS.

### D. Machine Learning & MLOps
- **URL**: https://whizzlylab.com/services/machine-learning
- **Overview**: Supervised and deep neural network models with continuous evaluation loops, model registries, and automated retraining workflows.
- **Key Deliverables**: Custom dataset preparation, model training & hyperparameter tuning, model registry (MLflow), automated inference APIs, drift monitoring.
- **Technology Stack**: PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, MLflow, Hugging Face, Docker.

### E. Workflow Automation & Integration
- **URL**: https://whizzlylab.com/services/automation
- **Overview**: Autonomous workflow automations, third-party integrations, webhook listeners, and background job processing pipelines.
- **Key Deliverables**: Custom business logic automation, CRM / ERP / payment gateways integration (Stripe, HubSpot), cron schedulers, alert notifications.
- **Technology Stack**: Python, Celery, Redis, Next.js, Webhooks, REST APIs.

### F. Data Analytics & Business Intelligence
- **URL**: https://whizzlylab.com/services/data-analytics
- **Overview**: Interactive business intelligence dashboards, real-time analytics aggregations, and predictive reporting.
- **Key Deliverables**: Custom interactive dashboards, automated ETL aggregation jobs, data visualization widgets, KPI reporting.
- **Technology Stack**: Python, Pandas, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Apache Superset, Next.js.

### G. Computer Vision
- **URL**: https://whizzlylab.com/services/computer-vision
- **Overview**: Real-time object detection, image classification, segmentation, and video stream analysis.
- **Key Deliverables**: Neural vision models (YOLO, OpenCV, PyTorch), edge & cloud deployment, video frame analysis pipelines.
- **Technology Stack**: OpenCV, PyTorch, YOLO, TorchVision, FastAPI.

### H. Business Solutions
- **URL**: https://whizzlylab.com/services/business-solutions
- **Overview**: Custom enterprise software solutions designed to replace fragmented legacy tools with unified digital platforms.
- **Key Deliverables**: Custom SaaS portals, multi-tenant architectures, role-based access control, billing & invoicing integration.

## 3. Shipped Flagship Case Studies

1. **EchoSense (Real-Time Crisis NLP Pipeline)**:
   - Built with Apache Kafka, Spark NLP, and Hugging Face.
   - Flags high-priority crisis indicators from continuous live streams.
   - Deployed at: https://hamzavelous-echosense-ai.hf.space/login
   - Outcome: 70% faster signal detection and zero silent pipeline failures.

2. **CureCMS Solution (Healthcare AI & RCM)**:
   - Intelligent revenue cycle management (RCM) and automated medical billing agents for healthcare providers.
   - Strict HIPAA compliance and audit trail generation.
   - Live platform: https://curercmsolution.com/

3. **COMPLYSECOPS (Cybersecurity & SaaS Platform)**:
   - Unified compliance and cybersecurity consulting platform with built-in AI documentation assistant.
   - Replaced multiple disjointed tools, saving engineering teams 15+ hours per week.
   - Live platform: https://complysecops.netlify.app/

4. **OXO Packaging (High-Volume Custom E-Commerce)**:
   - Custom quoting engine, dynamic packaging pricing calculator, and wholesale order flows.
   - Live platform: https://umairpackaging.netlify.app/
   - Outcome: Handles 500+ daily bulk orders.
